name: Topik 15 WP
description: Selective post-emergence herbicide for control of grassy weeds, especially Phalaris minor (Canary grass), in wheat crops.
effective_stages: post-emergence, 30-35 DAS, weed 3-4 leaf stage, tillering
resistance_management: Use in rotation with herbicides having different modes of action to delay resistance development in grassy weeds.
directions: Apply 30-35 days after sowing when grassy weeds are at 3-4 leaf stage. Mix 400 g in 375-400 litres of water per hectare. Spray uniformly using a flat fan nozzle. Best results are obtained on actively growing weeds. Do not spray before rain or on stressed crops.

name: Score 250 EC
description: Broad-spectrum systemic triazole fungicide effective against leaf rust, leaf spots, blight, and mildew diseases in multiple crops.
target_crop: wheat, mustard, chickpea, lentil, barley, oilseed rape, cabbage, cauliflower, broccoli, kale, brussels sprouts
target_pest: leaf rust, leaf spot, blight, mildew, fungal diseases
effective_stages: tillering, flowering, pod formation, canopy development, general
resistance_management: Avoid repeated consecutive applications of FRAC Group 3 fungicides. Rotate with fungicides of different modes of action.
directions: Mix 20 ml in 20 litres of water for knapsack spraying. Spray evenly on crop foliage at early disease appearance or preventively. Use 200 ml per acre or 500 ml per hectare. Do not spray during strong sunlight or rain. Maintain a 14-day interval before harvest.

name: Actara 25 WG
description: Systemic neonicotinoid insecticide with fast stomach and contact action for effective control of sucking and chewing pests including aphids, whiteflies, borers, and leafminers.
target_crop: mustard, maize, potato, chickpea, tomato, brassica, cabbage, cauliflower, broccoli, coffee, tobacco, capsicum, leafy vegetables, roses
target_pest: aphid, whitefly, borer, leafminer, leafhopper, potato snout beetle, sucking pests
effective_stages: vegetative, flowering, pod formation, transplanting, general
application_mode: foliar spray, soil drench, in-furrow application
resistance_management: Do not apply more than 3-4 consecutive sprays. Rotate with insecticides having different IRAC groups to delay resistance development.
directions: Spray at first sign of aphids, whiteflies, or sucking pests. Use recommended dose based on crop and pest severity. Ensure uniform leaf coverage using fine spray droplets. Avoid spraying during flowering to protect pollinators. Do not spray on drought-stressed crops or before rain. Repeat after 14-21 days only if pest population rebuilds.

name: Kavach 75 WP
description: Broad-spectrum non-systemic contact fungicide effective against early blight, late blight, tikka disease, rust, anthracnose, downy mildew, and fruit rot in multiple crops.
target_crop: potato, groundnut, grapes, chillies, chickpea, cumin
target_pest: early blight, late blight, tikka disease, rust, anthracnose, downy mildew, fruit rot, fungal diseases
effective_stages: tillering, vegetative, flowering, pod formation, general
resistance_management: Multi-site contact fungicide with low resistance risk. Can be rotated or tank-mixed with systemic fungicides for improved resistance management.
directions: Spray preventively before disease spreads widely. Use 0.875-1.25 kg per hectare mixed in 600-800 litres of water for potato blight management. Ensure complete foliage coverage using knapsack or power sprayer. Repeat sprays at recommended intervals during humid conditions. Do not mix with incompatible pesticides unless compatibility is known. Avoid spraying before rainfall.

name: Amistar 250 SC
description: Broad-spectrum systemic and preventive fungicide with curative activity against rusts, blights, leaf spots, downy mildew, powdery mildew, and other fungal diseases in cereals, vegetables, oilseeds, and legumes.
target_crop: wheat, barley, maize, potato, tomato, brassica, sunflower, carrot, tobacco, peppers, chickpea, lentil, mustard
target_pest: rust, septoria, blight, mildew, leaf spot, anthracnose, downy mildew, fungal diseases
effective_stages: vegetative, tillering, flowering, early disease development, general
application_mode: foliar spray, ground application, aerial application, in-furrow
resistance_management: Do not apply more than two consecutive sprays before rotating with fungicides from different FRAC groups. Maximum 2-3 applications per season depending on crop.
directions: Apply preventively before disease spreads. Use 500-1000 ml per hectare depending on crop and disease pressure. Spray uniformly for full foliage coverage. Repeat after 7-14 days if conditions favour disease development. Do not exceed two consecutive applications before rotating to another fungicide group. Avoid contaminating irrigation water or ponds during spraying.

name: Alto 5 SC
description: Systemic triazole fungicide with strong curative activity against rusts, powdery mildew, leaf spots, blights, and other fungal diseases in cereals, legumes, and oilseed crops.
target_pest: rust, powdery mildew, aerial blight, alternaria leaf spot, anthracnose, brown spot, cercospora leaf spot, cercospora blight, early leaf spot, late leaf spot, foot rot, frogeye leaf spot, glume blotch, helminthosporium leaf blight, leaf blight, limb rot, pod and stem blight, southern stem blight, spot blotch, tan spot, web blotch
effective_stages: tillering, vegetative, flowering, disease onset, general
resistance_management: Rotate with fungicides from different FRAC groups to reduce risk of resistance development. Avoid repeated exclusive use of Group 3 fungicides.
directions: Apply at early disease appearance or when weather favours fungal development. Spray evenly for complete crop coverage. Suitable for tank mixing with compatible fungicides and insecticides. Repeat application based on disease pressure and crop stage. Avoid spraying before rainfall or during strong winds.

name: Vertimec 1.8 EC
description: Biological-origin insecticide and acaricide with strong contact and stomach action against mites and leaf-feeding insect pests.
target_crop: brinjal, jujube, litchi, tea, potato, chickpea, cumin, maize
target_pest: red spider mites, mites, red mites, borers
effective_stages: vegetative, flowering, pod formation, early infestation, general
resistance_management: Rotate with insecticides from different IRAC groups and avoid continuous repeated applications to delay resistance.
directions: Spray at first appearance of mites or pest infestation. Mix 1.2-1.25 ml per litre of water depending on crop. Ensure complete coverage on the underside of leaves where mites hide. Do not spray during peak sunlight or before rain. Repeat only if pest population persists.

name: Axial 50 EC
description: Selective post-emergence ACCase inhibitor herbicide for control of wild oats, ryegrass, canary grass, and grassy weeds in wheat and barley crops.
target_pest: wild oats, ryegrass, little seeded canary grass, italian ryegrass, setaria glauca, grassy weeds
effective_stages: post-emergence, tillering, 2-4 leaf weed stage, general
resistance_management: Rotate with herbicides from different HRAC groups and avoid continuous use on resistant grass weed populations.
directions: Apply only on young actively growing weeds at 2-4 leaf stage. Use 900 ml per hectare with at least 200 litres water per hectare. Spray evenly using flat fan nozzles for complete weed coverage. Do not delay spraying beyond 4-leaf weed stage as control may reduce. Avoid spraying under stress conditions or before rainfall. Do not apply more than once per season.

name: Cruiser 350 FS
description: Systemic seed treatment insecticide that provides early-season protection against sucking and soil pests, ensuring strong crop establishment and vigorous seedling growth.
target_crop: corn, soybean, cotton, maize, wheat, chickpea, mustard, potato
target_pest: aphids, borers, soil insects, early-season sucking pests
effective_stages: seed treatment, sowing, germination, early seedling stage
resistance_management: Avoid repeated use of Group 4A insecticides across consecutive crop cycles to reduce resistance development.
directions: Apply directly as seed treatment before sowing. Use 6-8 ml per kg seed for soybean and corn, and 8-10 ml per kg seed for cotton. Mix thoroughly to ensure uniform seed coating. Allow treated seeds to dry in shade before sowing. Use protective gloves while handling treated seeds.

name: Tilt 250 EC
description: Systemic triazole fungicide providing long-lasting preventive and curative control of rusts, leaf spots, mildew, and other fungal diseases in cereals, fruits, and field crops.
target_crop: wheat, barley, lentil, mustard, rice, mango
target_pest: stem rust, leaf spot, powdery mildew, blight, fungal diseases
resistance_management: Rotate with fungicides having different FRAC groups to reduce risk of resistance development. Avoid repeated continuous use.
directions: Apply at early disease appearance or when weather favours fungal infection. Use 200 ml per acre for wheat stem rust, 80 ml per acre for rice leaf spot, and 100 ml in 100 litres water for mango powdery mildew. Ensure thorough foliage coverage during spraying. Avoid spraying before rainfall and maintain recommended pre-harvest intervals.

name: Movondo
description: Selective post-emergence herbicide for effective control of annual grasses and broadleaf weeds in wheat, maize, and soybean crops.
target_pest: phalaris minor, echinochloa crusgalli, echinochloa colomum, eleusine indica, phyllanthus niruri, celosia argentia, trianthema portulacastrum, amaranthus viridis, digeria arvensis, annual grasses, broadleaf weeds
resistance_management: Rotate with herbicides having different modes of action to reduce weed resistance development.
directions: Apply as a post-emergence spray on actively growing weeds. Use 150 ml formulation per hectare mixed in 500 litres of water. Ensure uniform spray coverage on weeds for best control. Avoid spraying during windy conditions or before rainfall. Observe waiting period before harvest and avoid field re-entry until spray deposits dry.

name: Vibrance Integral
active_ingredients: Sedaxane 15% w/v + Azoxystrobin 3.75% w/v + Thiamethoxam 26.25% w/v FS
description: Broad-spectrum fungicide and insecticide seed treatment providing protection against seedling diseases and early-season insect pests in rice and other crops.
target_crop: rice, wheat, maize, chickpea, lentil, potato
target_pest: sheath blight, leaf blast, brown spot, green leaf hopper, thrips, whorl maggot, seed rot, damping-off, root rot, fungal diseases
effective_stages: seed treatment, sowing, germination, seedling stage
resistance_management: Contains multiple modes of action for improved resistance management. Avoid repeated use of products with the same FRAC and IRAC groups.
directions: Soak rice seeds in water for 24-48 hours and drain excess water. Mix 3 ml product per kg seed with 8-10 ml water to prepare slurry. Coat seeds uniformly using seed treatment drum or plastic bag. Dry treated seeds in shade before incubation or sowing. Use only healthy undamaged seeds and avoid overdosing.
